message: The frozen centered 18.6 um, 373 x 373 production grid now has a validated finite nonperiodic 500 nm conic filter and tanh projection. Constant preservation and opposite-edge wrap errors are exactly zero, worst JVP/VJP Cauchy-normalized error is 1.290e-15, and all 25 beta/direction mapping-only centered-FD trajectories converge under h-to-h/2 with worst finest-step relative error 8.706e-6. The first overly strict all-step gate remains a failed diagnostic; no value was rescaled. No Maxwell solve, thermal solve, CPU FDTD fallback, or optimization iteration was used. Gray-law sensitivity, broader combined directions, exact-binary DRC fixtures, and full latent AD-FD still block optimization.
